name: Lady Maribel Quince
description: Elegant, commanding, and visibly terrified that the evening's disaster will ruin both her reputation and her fortune.

name: Orin Vale
description: A polished inventor with old grievances against the missing man and the misfortune of being named by the swan's message.

name: Professor Selda Morcant
description: Precise, severe, and more offended by impossible machinery than by personal insult.

name: Pip Tallow
description: A nervous young mechanic who knows Halcyon House's gears, ducts, and service passages better than any guest.

name: Captain Rusk Fen
description: A square-shouldered officer hired to keep order at the gala, carrying a notebook full of clean conclusions and carefully omitted inconveniences.
